goal: Develop the independent HF forward evaluator; advance NumPy equilibrium after the full static force/CSC corpus passed.
authorization: User authorized NumPy full force/reference comparison and subsequent assembly, tangent and equilibrium, and automatic project development. This is a new NumPy stage; no old execution window is reused.
input: inputs: exact h=.125 C1 factory/model, original solver protocol, saved unit fluctuation direction, historical HP curve only for comparison

stages.handoff: Explicit stored lift and fluctuation; compression independently checks inherited s=0 state. No display-array initialization.

budget.enforcement: Original cooperative solver clock; audit between-state/between-precision clock; RSS at accepted states/audit checkpoints. Not a hard process supervisor. Preparation, tests, rendering and delivery recorded separately.

completion: Both stages reach all original targets and each actual accepted record passes a newly computed HP80/120 numerical audit; show actual x1 geometry, reactions, components, J, gap and mesh comparison.
stop: First solver failure, resource checkpoint failure or precision gate failure stops dependent work. Preserve accepted prefix and failure; no gate relaxation or automatic same-stage retry.
scope_limit: Numerical C1 equilibrium qualification, not general contact/release or full original physical admission. Full top reaction includes background medium; not real workpiece clamping force. No LF import/optimization, HF5 labels, ranking, default-kernel change or factory material change.
